The path from stuck to safe

A self-paced, step-by-step course to understand your nervous system, build resilience, and gently guide yourself out of your body's defenses, using Polyvagal Theory.

One path instead of a mountain of courses

The Unstucking Pathway clears away the overwhelm that comes from a pile of courses you won't finish. It's one place to learn and practice, and it moves forward as you build mastery. Every lesson is under 10 minutes, and you won't ever wonder what to work on next.

  1. Learn the theory
  2. Build safety
  3. Unstuck defense

What's on the Pathway

Guidance and practice, in small steps

Guidance from Justin

I walk with you every step, through small lessons and guided practices.

  • Short lessons and guided practices, so you can make progress every day.
  • Live Q&A sessions to get your own questions answered in a supportive setting.
  • A clear roadmap, grounded in neuroscience, from being stuck in defense to feeling safe and connected.

Practical tools

Small, easy actions and practices that create change you can keep.

  • Guided meditations from me, to practice and master self-regulation skills.
  • Small daily practices to notice what's happening in your body and use Polyvagal Theory in your life.
  • Short lessons followed by small practices you can do any time.

Your progress comes with you into the app

Every Academy membership includes the full Stuck Not Broken app. The app has the same path, as practice: it opens the next skill when your practices show you can handle the last one. Steps you've completed in the Academy open there too.
